title: Running balance (Checking)
context: Cumulative sum of amount over time.
task: Set result to a DataFrame tx_id, date, balance for account_id == 1, where balance is the cumulative sum of amount ordered by date then tx_id, rounded to 2 dp.
answer:
c = transactions[transactions['account_id'] == 1].sort_values(['date', 'tx_id']).copy()
c['balance'] = c['amount'].cumsum().round(2)
result = c[['tx_id', 'date', 'balance']].reset_index(drop=True)

title: Running balance per account
task: Set result to transactions with a column balance = cumulative sum of amount within each account_id, ordered by date then tx_id (2 dp); keep tx_id, account_id, balance.
answer:
t = transactions.sort_values(['account_id', 'date', 'tx_id']).copy()
t['balance'] = t.groupby('account_id')['amount'].cumsum().round(2)
result = t[['tx_id', 'account_id', 'balance']].reset_index(drop=True)

title: Month-end balance (Checking)
task: Set result to a Series indexed by 'YYYY-MM' of the Checking (account 1) balance at each month end, sorted by month.
hint: running balance then take last per month.
answer:
c = transactions[transactions['account_id'] == 1].sort_values(['date', 'tx_id']).copy()
c['balance'] = c['amount'].cumsum()
c['month'] = c['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
result = c.groupby('month')['balance'].last().round(2).sort_index()

title: Days the balance went negative
task: Set result to the number of Checking (account 1) transactions after which the running balance was negative (an int).
answer:
c = transactions[transactions['account_id'] == 1].sort_values(['date', 'tx_id']).copy()
c['balance'] = c['amount'].cumsum()
result = int((c['balance'] < 0).sum())

title: 3-month rolling spend
task: Set result to a Series of the 3-month rolling mean of total monthly spend (abs debit), rounded to 0 dp, NaNs dropped, sorted by month.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit']
m = d.groupby(d['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m'))['amount'].sum().abs().sort_index()
result = m.rolling(3).mean().dropna().round()

title: Month-over-month spend change
task: Set result to a Series of month-over-month change in total spend (abs debit), first month dropped, rounded to 2 dp, sorted by month.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit']
m = d.groupby(d['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m'))['amount'].sum().abs().sort_index()
result = m.diff().dropna().round(2)

title: Anomalous transactions (z-score)
task: Set result to a DataFrame tx_id, category, amount of debit transactions whose absolute amount is more than 3 category-standard-deviations above the category mean (population std), sorted by tx_id.
hint: per-category mean/std via transform on abs amount.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].dropna(subset=['amount']).copy()
d['a'] = d['amount'].abs()
mu = d.groupby('category')['a'].transform('mean')
sd = d.groupby('category')['a'].transform(lambda s: s.std(ddof=0))
z = (d['a'] - mu) / sd
result = d.loc[z > 3, ['tx_id', 'category', 'amount']].sort_values('tx_id').reset_index(drop=True)

title: Largest single expense
task: Set result to a DataFrame with one row (tx_id, merchant, amount) for the most negative transaction.
answer: result = transactions.nsmallest(1, 'amount')[['tx_id', 'merchant', 'amount']].reset_index(drop=True)

title: Monthly budget breaches
context: Which months exceeded budget per category.
task: Set result to a DataFrame category, month, spend, monthly_budget for (category, month) pairs where spend exceeds the budget, sorted by category then month.
hint: monthly spend per category, merge budgets, filter.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
d['month'] = d['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
sp = d.groupby(['category', 'month'])['amount'].sum().abs().rename('spend').reset_index()
m = sp.merge(budgets, on='category')
result = m[m['spend'] > m['monthly_budget']].sort_values(['category', 'month']).reset_index(drop=True)

title: Total overspend
task: Set result to the total overspend = sum over (category, month) of max(0, spend − budget), rounded to 2 dp.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
d['month'] = d['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
sp = d.groupby(['category', 'month'])['amount'].sum().abs().rename('spend').reset_index()
m = sp.merge(budgets, on='category')
result = round(float((m['spend'] - m['monthly_budget']).clip(lower=0).sum()), 2)

title: Recurring merchants
task: Set result to a Series of merchant names that appear in 6 or more distinct months, with the count of months, sorted descending.
answer:
t = transactions.assign(month=transactions['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m'))
g = t.groupby('merchant')['month'].nunique()
result = g[g >= 6].sort_values(ascending=False)

title: Days between salary credits
task: Set result to a Series of the number of days between consecutive salary credits (category 'Salary'), ordered by date, first dropped.
answer:
s = transactions[transactions['category'] == 'Salary'].sort_values('date')
result = s['date'].diff().dt.days.dropna().astype(int).reset_index(drop=True)

title: Merchants = 50% of spend
task: Set result to the number of merchants (fewest, by spend) whose cumulative spend first reaches 50% of total spending (abs debit) (an int).
hint: spend per merchant desc, cumsum/total, count where prev<0.5.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit']
sp = d.groupby('merchant')['amount'].sum().abs().sort_values(ascending=False)
cum = sp.cumsum() / sp.sum()
result = int((cum.shift(fill_value=0) < 0.5).sum())

title: Category share of spend
task: Set result to a Series (indexed by category) of category spend as a % of total spend (abs debit), rounded to 1 dp, sorted descending.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit']
sp = d.groupby('category')['amount'].sum().abs()
result = (sp / sp.sum() * 100).round(1).sort_values(ascending=False)

title: Spend matrix category x month
task: Set result to a pivot_table: index category, columns month ('YYYY-MM'), values abs spend, aggfunc sum, fill_value 0, only debit rows.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
d['month'] = d['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
d['spend'] = d['amount'].abs()
result = d.pivot_table(index='category', columns='month', values='spend', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)

title: Cumulative savings balance
task: Set result to a Series indexed by date of the cumulative balance of account 2 (Savings), sorted by date.
hint: filter account 2, sort, cumsum indexed by date.
answer:
s = transactions[transactions['account_id'] == 2].sort_values(['date', 'tx_id'])
result = s.set_index('date')['amount'].cumsum().round(2)

title: Weekly spend
task: Set result to a Series of total spending (abs debit) resampled weekly (W-MON) over the whole period, indexed by week start.
hint: set date index, filter debit, resample('W-MON').
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].set_index('date').sort_index()
result = d['amount'].abs().resample('W-MON').sum()

title: Daily spend with zero-fill
task: Set result to a Series of total spending (abs debit) per calendar day resampled daily over the data range (missing days = 0), for the first 10 days only.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].set_index('date').sort_index()
result = d['amount'].abs().resample('D').sum().head(10)

title: Spend percentiles
task: Set result to a list of the 50th, 90th and 99th percentiles of absolute debit amounts (0 dp each).
answer:
amt = transactions.loc[transactions['type'] == 'debit', 'amount'].abs().dropna()
result = [round(float(x), 0) for x in np.percentile(amt, [50, 90, 99])]

title: Net worth over time
task: Set result to a Series indexed by 'YYYY-MM' of total net worth = cumulative sum of all transaction amounts (all accounts) at each month end, sorted by month.
hint: sort all by date, cumsum, month last.
answer:
t = transactions.sort_values(['date', 'tx_id']).copy()
t['nw'] = t['amount'].cumsum()
t['month'] = t['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
result = t.groupby('month')['nw'].last().round(2).sort_index()

title: Income vs spend correlation
context: Do high-income months mean high spend?
task: Set result to the Pearson correlation between monthly income and monthly spend (abs debit), rounded to 2 dp.
answer:
g = transactions.assign(month=transactions['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m'))
inc = g[g['type'] == 'credit'].groupby('month')['amount'].sum()
sp = g[g['type'] == 'debit'].groupby('month')['amount'].apply(lambda s: s.abs().sum())
result = round(float(inc.corr(sp)), 2)

title: Above category-average spend
task: Set result to the number of debit transactions whose absolute amount exceeds the mean absolute amount of their category (an int).
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].dropna(subset=['amount']).copy()
d['a'] = d['amount'].abs()
mean = d.groupby('category')['a'].transform('mean')
result = int((d['a'] > mean).sum())

title: Rank categories by spend
task: Set result to a DataFrame category, spend, rank (dense, 1=highest) for the top 5 categories by total spend (abs debit), sorted by rank.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit']
sp = d.groupby('category')['amount'].sum().abs().reset_index(name='spend')
sp['rank'] = sp['spend'].rank(ascending=False, method='dense').astype(int)
result = sp.sort_values('spend', ascending=False).head(5).reset_index(drop=True)

title: First-of-month charges
task: Set result to a Series of total spending (abs debit) that occurs on the 1st of any month, per category, sorted descending.
hint: filter day==1 & debit, groupby category abs sum.
answer:
d = transactions[(transactions['type'] == 'debit') & (transactions['date'].dt.day == 1)]
result = d.groupby('category')['amount'].apply(lambda s: s.abs().sum()).sort_values(ascending=False)

title: Longest no-spend streak
task: Set result to the length (int) of the longest run of consecutive calendar days in the data range with zero spending.
hint: daily spend resample, find longest run of zeros.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].set_index('date').sort_index()
daily = d['amount'].abs().resample('D').sum()
zero = (daily == 0).astype(int)
grp = (zero != zero.shift()).cumsum()
runs = zero.groupby(grp).sum()
result = int(runs.max())

title: Category summary
task: Set result to a DataFrame indexed by category with txns (count), total_spend (abs debit sum, 0 dp) and avg_spend (abs debit mean, 0 dp), debit rows only, sorted by total_spend descending.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
d['a'] = d['amount'].abs()
result = d.groupby('category').agg(txns=('tx_id', 'count'), total_spend=('a', 'sum'), avg_spend=('a', 'mean')).round().sort_values('total_spend', ascending=False)

title: Spend vs budget table
task: Set result to a DataFrame indexed by category with avg_monthly_spend (0 dp), monthly_budget and status ('Over' if avg > budget else 'OK'), for budgeted categories, sorted by category.
hint: avg monthly spend, join budgets, np.where.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
d['month'] = d['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
avg = d.groupby(['category', 'month'])['amount'].sum().abs().groupby('category').mean().round().rename('avg_monthly_spend')
m = budgets.set_index('category').join(avg).dropna()
m['status'] = np.where(m['avg_monthly_spend'] > m['monthly_budget'], 'Over', 'OK')
result = m[['avg_monthly_spend', 'monthly_budget', 'status']].sort_index()

title: Income vs spend wide
task: Set result to a DataFrame indexed by month ('YYYY-MM') with columns income (sum credits) and spend (abs sum debits), sorted by month, missing filled 0.
hint: pivot_table on type or two groupbys joined.
answer:
g = transactions.assign(month=transactions['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m'))
inc = g[g['type'] == 'credit'].groupby('month')['amount'].sum().rename('income')
sp = g[g['type'] == 'debit'].groupby('month')['amount'].apply(lambda s: s.abs().sum()).rename('spend')
result = pd.concat([inc, sp], axis=1).fillna(0).round(2).sort_index()

title: Duplicate charges
context: Same merchant, same amount, same day.
task: Set result to the number of transactions that share merchant, date and amount with at least one other transaction (an int).
answer:
dup = transactions.duplicated(subset=['merchant', 'date', 'amount'], keep=False)
result = int(dup.sum())

title: 7-day rolling spend
task: Set result to a Series of the 7-day rolling sum of daily spending (abs debit), NaNs dropped, for the first 15 valid days.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].set_index('date').sort_index()
daily = d['amount'].abs().resample('D').sum()
result = daily.rolling(7).sum().dropna().head(15)

title: Cumulative savings rate
task: Set result to a Series indexed by 'YYYY-MM' of cumulative net / cumulative income to date, rounded to 3 dp, sorted by month.
hint: monthly net and income, cumsum, divide.
answer:
g = transactions.assign(month=transactions['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m'))
net = g.groupby('month')['amount'].sum().sort_index().cumsum()
inc = g[g['type'] == 'credit'].groupby('month')['amount'].sum().sort_index().cumsum()
result = (net / inc).round(3)

title: Merchant frequency vs value
task: Set result to a DataFrame indexed by merchant with count (transactions) and avg_spend (mean abs debit, 0 dp) for debit merchants with 10+ transactions, sorted by count descending.
hint: debit, groupby merchant agg, filter count.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
d['a'] = d['amount'].abs()
g = d.groupby('merchant').agg(count=('tx_id', 'count'), avg_spend=('a', 'mean'))
g['avg_spend'] = g['avg_spend'].round()
result = g[g['count'] >= 10].sort_values('count', ascending=False)

title: Quarter-over-quarter spend
task: Set result to a Series of total spending (abs debit) per calendar quarter (indexed by quarter-end date), using resample('QE') — or 'Q' if QE unavailable.
hint: set date index, resample quarterly sum.
